Large turning: shafts up to 4 m long, flanges up to ø1,600 mm

Big, heavy and awkward parts are what our manual shop is built for. With 24 horizontal lathes, Weng Loi Machinery in Ipoh turns shafts up to 4 m long and ø300 mm on long-bed lathes, and faces flanges and plates up to ø1,600 mm on a face lathe: the one-off and urgent jobs that many CNC shops turn away.

Typical large jobs

  • Long shafts and roller shafts
  • Rollers and drums, re-turned and finished
  • Large rings, flanges and faceplate work
  • Screw conveyors and augers
  • Mixer and paddle shafts
  • Ring gears and large gear blanks
  • Keyways on large shafts and hubs
  • Build-up welding and re-machining of large worn parts

Why manual for large parts

For one-off and repair work on large parts, a skilled machinist on a manual lathe can set up and start cutting quickly, without programming. Our chief machinist has 30 years with Weng Loi, and our founder has more than 50 years at the lathe.

Recent work

Frequently asked questions

What is the maximum size you can turn?

These are two different machines. Our long-bed lathes turn shafts up to 4,000 mm (4 m) long and ø300 mm in diameter. Our face lathe takes flanges and plates up to ø1,600 mm in diameter. Send the diameter, length and weight of your part and we will confirm which lathe can take it.

Can you cut keyways on large shafts?

Yes. Our slotters cut keyways on parts up to ø600 mm, and our vertical milling machines (for example the HV-8, 800 × 500 × 500 mm travel) handle the milling steps.

Do you repair large rollers and drums?

Yes. We re-turn and finish worn rollers and drums, and can build up worn areas by welding before re-machining.

Can you machine a large part without a drawing?

Yes. We can measure the original part and machine a replacement or a repair to match.

How do I get a quote for a large part?

WhatsApp a photo with the main dimensions and approximate weight to Lily at 017-701 4268, or call. You can also bring the part to our workshop in Menglembu, Ipoh.
